strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Stochastic
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > (donchian_high(high, 9) + donchian_low(low, 9) + donchian_high(high, 26) + donchian_low(low, 26)) / 4 and 100 * (close - donchian_low(low, 14)) / (donchian_high(high, 14) - donchian_low(low, 14)) < 20
strategy_roster.notes: The cloud top is the unshifted Tenkan 9 / Kijun 26 average and the entry keeps the documented StochK 14 < 20 pullback condition, with a close back under the cloud as the opposite breakout exit. The 26-bar forward projection of the spans, Senkou 52, K/D smoothing, and Ichimoku-boundary stops are not expressible; the stochastic denominator can be zero.

strategy_roster.name: Heiken Ashi Supertrend Adx
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and low >= open and close > ema(close, 10) + 3 * atr(high, low, close, 10)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close, 10) - 2 * atr(high, low, close, 10) or close < open
strategy_roster.notes: The bullish wick-less candle is approximated on raw OHLC, the Supertrend line uses the documented AtrPeriod 10 with multiplier 3, and the exit band uses the documented TrailAtrMultiplier 2; the ADX filter is not applied because UseAdxFilter defaults to false. Heiken-Ashi smoothing, the incremental ATR trail, and the 15-minute timeframe are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Cyberia Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: macd(close, 12, 26) > macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9) and close > sma(close, 50) and rsi(close, 14) < 70 and roc(adx(high, low, close, 14), 1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: The four blocking filters are translated to the long side: MACD above signal, price above the MA, CCI below +100 as RSI(14) < 70, and +DI above -DI as rising ADX with the enable flags on. All periods are explicit fallbacks because no values are documented; the documented 1% stop and 2% target are retained.

strategy_roster.name: Early Top Prorate V1
strategy_roster.entry_long: high + low > 2 * open and close > open
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < open or high + low < 2 * open
strategy_roster.notes: The documented dominant-direction test (high - open versus open - low) is rewritten as high + low > 2*open, so a bullish day that closes above its open opens the long and the mirror closes. The StartHour/EndHour/ClosingHour window, the three prorated profit targets, break-even rescue, and money-management modes are not expressible in a daily DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Meeting Lines Stochastic
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and low <= open and (close - open) > (sma(close, 3) - sma(open, 3)) and 100 * (close - donchian_low(low, 3)) / (donchian_high(high, 3) - donchian_low(low, 3)) < 30
strategy_roster.notes: Bullish Meeting Lines are approximated by a bullish candle whose low sits at the open and whose body exceeds the documented BodyAveragePeriod 3 average body, confirmed by the documented LongEntryLevel 30; exits use ExitLowerLevel 20 or a bearish candle. StochasticSmoothing 25 and StochasticSignal 36 are dropped, the short side is omitted, and the oscillator denominator can be zero.

strategy_roster.name: Autotrader Momentum
strategy_roster.notes: The monitoring close is compared with the reference bar's close, reconstructed as close/(1+roc(close,1)/100), so a bullish momentum shift buys and the bearish shift closes; the reference offset of one bar is a fallback because ComparableBarIndex has no documented value. Pip stop/target/trailing and the 1-hour timeframe are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Step Stochastic Cross
strategy_roster.notes: The ATR-based Step Stochastic is rebuilt as fast and slow EMA channels offset by 1x and 3x ATR(14), with a reclaim of the fast channel buying and losing the slow channel exiting; the multipliers are explicit fallbacks because KFast and KSlow carry no values. The price-unit stop/target and the buy/sell permission flags are not roster fields.

strategy_roster.name: Quantum Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: The two documented long triggers are kept: a touch of the lower Bollinger band (length 20 fallback) or a smoothed RSI below the 30 oversold level. 'Closed once profitable' has no price-free expression, so an EMA(10) recovery is the exit proxy, and no lengths, stops, or short side are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Double Trading
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy opens offsetting positions in two correlated securities with a required SecondSecurity and no market-derived trigger, so the impossible negative-price guard avoids inventing one. Combined profit targeting, Volume1/Volume2 sizing, and cross-instrument pairs logic are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Time Range Statistics
strategy_roster.notes: The documented decision is the sign of the percent change between StartIndex 9000 and EndIndex 10000, which on daily bars is approximated by ROC(21); a positive window change buys and a negative one closes since no exit is documented. The mean/range/volume/gap logging, gap count, and intraday bar indexing are not signals.
